#!/bin/bash ADB=/home/boaz-sagini/Android/Sdk/platform-tools/adb S="$ADB -s emulator-5554" P=com.example.myapplication
$S exec-out screencap -p > /tmp/final_main.png python3 /tmp/dark_analyze.py /tmp/final_main.png
echo "overlay windows: $($S shell dumpsys window windows | grep -cE 'Window #[0-9]+ Window\{[0-9a-f]+ u0 com\.example\.myapplication\}')" echo "crash lines: $($S logcat -d -b crash | wc -l)" echo "system night mode: $($S shell cmd uimode night)" echo "overlay permission: $($S shell appops get $P SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW | cut -c1-40)" echo "installed: $($S shell dumpsys package $P | grep lastUpdateTime)"
echo "--- git status" cd /home/boaz-sagini/AndroidStudioProjects/TestingAgain && git --no-pager status --short
# Tidy up temp files created during testing. rm -f /tmp/e2e_*.py /tmp/e2e_*.png /tmp/dbg_*.png /tmp/dark_* /tmp/final_main.png /tmp/manual.png \ /tmp/persist.sh /tmp/recents.sh /tmp/recents2.sh /tmp/swipeaway.sh /tmp/overlay_probe.sh \ /tmp/monitor*.sh /tmp/monitor*.log /tmp/full.log /tmp/t.xml rm -rf /tmp/__pycache__ echo "temp files cleaned"

#!/bin/bash ADB=/home/boaz-sagini/Android/Sdk/platform-tools/adb S="$ADB -s emulator-5554" P=com.jubileegroup.jbuzz cd /home/boaz-sagini/AndroidStudioProjects/TestingAgain || exit 1
# main screen is still dark? (screenshot from the release smoke test) python3 - <<'EOF' from PIL import Image im = Image.open("/tmp/restore_main.png").convert("RGB") px = list(im.getdata()) dark = sum(1 for r, g, b in px if r < 40 and g < 40 and b < 40) print("main screen: %.1f %% of pixels are dark" % (100.0 * dark / len(px))) EOF
# leave the debug build installed, as it was $S uninstall $P > /dev/null $S install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk | tail -1 $S shell appops set $P SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow $S shell pm grant $P android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS $S shell am force-stop $P echo "debuggable: $($S shell dumpsys package $P | grep -c 'DEBUGGABLE')"
# temp files from this check rm -f /tmp/restore_check.py /tmp/restore_check_release.py /tmp/compare_ref.py /tmp/cmp_ref.png /tmp/cmp_ours.png \ /tmp/restore_main.png /tmp/restore_card.png /tmp/restore_ui.xml /tmp/restore_build.log /tmp/restore_connected.log \ /tmp/restore_release.log rm -rf /tmp/__pycache__
echo "--- git status" git --no-pager status --short | grep -v '^ D app/src/main/res/mipmap'
